node.title: L1 Pade-remainder Jacobian and tangent dichotomy
node.statement: For monic degree-a locator L with Euclidean division U=LQ+P, the differential of the remainder map in direction D is -(QD mod L). If gcd(L,Q)=1, multiplication by Q is an automorphism of F[Z]/(L), so the full remainder Jacobian has rank a and the w=a-k high-remainder Pade equations have rank exactly w. Thus the section is a smooth local complete intersection of codimension w there, and every rank-deficient point lies on Res(L,Q)=0. For exact split locators the complement guard gives the canonical partition gcd(Q,Omega)=1 versus tangent D=gcd(L,Q)!=1 with all D-roots inside the agreement support. An exact F_17 tangent witness has projected rank 2<3. No split-point bound or tangent payment is asserted.
